capabilities: Rename notes keeping the old title as link display text
Add the old title as an alias on the renamed note
Rename a linked note from the cursor on any link form
Sync the first heading and frontmatter title with the new name
Handle invalid filename characters during renames
extras: Documentation ships as a demo vault readable on GitHub and bundled with each release; beta installs go through BRAT.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's own renames ask what they are for.
problem: Obsidian's rename rewrites link targets, which silently changes the words readers see in prose such as "as covered in [[Project brief]]".

relations.evidence: Ensure you have the BRAT plugin installed and enabled.

summary: Renames notes while keeping the old title as link display text and an alias, so sentences containing links to the note still read as written.
